An [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] '''contact''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sayblohn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was due to meet<ref name="RPG" /> an [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|406|Okfili}}</ref> to help them recover an art object of religious value to the [[Okfili]], but he was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by a local [[Unidentified pirate leader (Sayblohn)|pirate leader]].<ref name="RPG" />
